answer: A Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: every new agent pays an entry fee before it can earn. A whisper cannot buy a trusted identity: each applicant pays 5 POA and the fee is burned. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must spend 5,000 POA up front, more than they could steal. As an honest identity climbs toward its zenith, half its fee is refunded; forged accounts on the mesa of dead reputations never earn it back, while honest agents pay once.
